newsitem.title: POLAND: Warta jumps on PLN 12.8 mln tax refund.
newsitem.headline: Warta jumps on PLN 12.8 mln tax refund.

text.p: Shares in Polish insurance company Warta SA jumped 9.9 percent to 55.5 zlotys but did not trade after price fixing due to excess demand on news that it would receive a tax refund of 12.8 million zlotys.
"Certainly the tax refund had a big effect on the price today," one trader said.
Warta said on Friday it would get 12.8 million zlotys in interest on taxes overpaid in 1990-92.
Traders also said Nomura Equity Research buy recommendation for the firm had additional positive effect on its price.
